description: React component for managing and displaying users assigned to a system role in Mattermost's admin console, including pagination, search, and user addition/removal functionalities.

classes.name: SystemRoleUsers
classes.description: React component class for managing users assigned to a system role, with functionalities for search, pagination, and user management.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial data fetch when component mounts, including profiles and user stats.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates when search term changes, with debounce for search.

methods.name: getVisibleTotalCount
methods.description: Calculates total user count considering additions and removals.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Calculates pagination start, end, and total counts.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Loads the next page of users.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Loads the previous page of users.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates data rows for the data grid, including user info and action buttons.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines columns for the data grid.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the admin panel with user list, search, and add user modal.
